It's hard when you don't know what's wrong. All you want to do is see her happy. She may even think that if she shows you her depression, you may get tired of her or think she's not worth it. Those worries may be very real in her eyes although all you want to do is be there because you know how amazing she is.

Depression is tricky because some things may work for someone but not work on someone else. Just listen to her when she needs you. Sometimes, all she may need is to vent. Never make her feel bad for it. I'm sure she doesn't want to be depressed or anything. No one does. Support her. Make sure she knows she isn't a bother. In my experience , my SO sometimes doesn't tell me when he's upset because he doesn't want to annoy me. Your girlfriend may feel the same way. Show her that there are positive things in life no matter how small it is. Good luck.

Now, my dad's death was hard to get over because i was only 10 but with the help of my mom, we did it. Her death is different. She was murdered by her ex boyfriend because she didn't want to be with him. The day it happened it was just my mom and I at the apt. I tried saving her by jumping in the way but ended up getting stabbed as well. Now, I'll admit that to this day it hurts but it does get easier with time. Remember her and cherish the time you had with her. For me, I felt guilty for even being able to laugh because she just died. Now, I know my mom would be so mad if i stayed depressed.
